      def on_body(chunk)

      RES_200_STATUS = "200 OK".freeze
      RES_403_STATUS = "403 Forbidden".freeze

      # Azure App Service sends GET requests for health checking purpose.
      # Respond with `200 OK` to accommodate it.
      def handle_get_request

      # Web browsers can send an OPTIONS request before performing POST
      # to check if cross-origin requests are supported.
      def handle_options_request

        if @access_control_request_method != 'POST'
          return send_response_and_close(RES_403_STATUS, {}, "")
        end

          "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => @access_control_request_headers || "",

          header["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = "*"
          send_response_and_close(RES_200_STATUS, header, "")
        elsif include_cors_allow_origin
          header["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"] = @origin
          if @cors_allow_credentials
            header["Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"] = true
          end
          send_response_and_close(RES_200_STATUS, header, "")
        else
          send_response_and_close(RES_403_STATUS, {}, "")
        end

      def on_message_complete

        if @parser.http_method == 'GET'.freeze

        end

        if @parser.http_method == 'OPTIONS'.freeze

        end

        # restrictions and allow listed origins through @cors_allow_origins.

          cors_pass = false

            cors_pass = true
          else
            if @origin.nil?
              cors_pass = false
            else
              if @cors_allow_origins.include?(@origin)
                cors_pass = true
              else
                filtered_cors_allow_origins = @cors_allow_origins.select {|origin| origin != ""}

                  cors_pass = false
                else
                  matched_origin = nil
                  filtered_cors_allow_origins.each do |origin|
                    start_str, end_str = origin.split("*", 2)
                    if @origin.start_with?(start_str)
                      if @origin.end_with?(end_str)
                        matched_origin = origin

        params = WEBrick::HTTPUtils.parse_query(uri.query)

        elsif @content_type =~ /^application\/x-www-form-urlencoded/

        if (@add_query_params)

        @env.clear

        owner = @callback.receiver
        respond_with_empty_img = owner.respond_with_empty_img
        use_204_response = owner.use_204_response
        dump_error_log = owner.dump_error_log
        add_http_headers = owner.add_http_headers
        add_remote_addr = owner.add_remote_addr
        custom_parser = owner.instance_variable_get(:@custom_parser)
        default_keep_time_key = owner.instance_variable_get(:@default_keep_time_key)
        parser_time_key = owner.instance_variable_get(:@parser_time_key)
        default_time_parser = owner.instance_variable_get(:@default_time_parser)
        plugin_log = owner.log

        code = nil
        header = nil
        body = nil
        mes = nil
        time = nil
        record = nil
        tag = nil

          tag = path.split('/').join('.')

                  }
                end

                  params.each_pair { |k, v|
                    if k.start_with?("QUERY_".freeze)
                      single_record[k] = v
                    end

                    nsec = now % 1_000_000_000

                  else

                      tz_offset = Fluent::Timezone.utc_offset(nil)
                      single_time = Fluent::EventTime.new(sec_s.to_i + tz_offset, nsec_s.to_i)

                      raise Fluent::TimeParser::TimeParseError, "invalid time format: value = #{param_time}, error_class = #{e.class.name}, error = #{e.message}"

                    end
                  else
                    now = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_REALTIME, :nanosecond)
                    sec = now / 1_000_000_000
                    nsec = now % 1_000_000_000
                    single_time = Fluent::EventTime.new(sec, nsec)
                  end
                end

                mes.add(single_time, single_record)
              end
            else
              if add_http_headers
                params.each_pair { |k, v|
                  if k.start_with?("HTTP_".freeze)
                    record[k] = v
                  end
                }
              end

              if @add_query_params
                params.each_pair { |k, v|
                  if k.start_with?("QUERY_".freeze)
                    record[k] = v
                  end
                }
              end

              if add_remote_addr
                record['REMOTE_ADDR'] = params['REMOTE_ADDR']
              end

              if param_time = params['time']
                param_time = param_time.to_f
                if param_time.zero?
                  now = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_REALTIME, :nanosecond)
                  sec = now / 1_000_000_000
                  nsec = now % 1_000_000_000
                  time = Fluent::EventTime.new(sec, nsec)
                else
                  begin
                    sec_s, nsec_s, _ = param_time.to_s.split('.', 3)
                    if nsec_s.nil?
                      nsec_s = '0'
                    else
                      nsec_s = nsec_s[0..9]
                      if nsec_s.size < 9
                        nsec_s += '0' * (9 - nsec_s.size)
                      end
                    end
                    tz_offset = Fluent::Timezone.utc_offset(nil)
                    time = Fluent::EventTime.new(sec_s.to_i + tz_offset, nsec_s.to_i)
                  rescue => e
                    raise Fluent::TimeParser::TimeParseError, "invalid time format: value = #{param_time}, error_class = #{e.class.name}, error = #{e.message}"
                  end
                end

                      time = default_time_parser.parse(t)

                      time = Fluent::EventTime.new(parsed_time.to_i, parsed_time.nsec)
                    end
                  else
                    now = Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_REALTIME, :nanosecond)
                    sec = now / 1_000_000_000
                    nsec = now % 1_000_000_000
                    time = Fluent::EventTime.new(sec, nsec)
                  end
                else

                end
              end
            end
          end
        rescue => e

            plugin_log.error "failed to process request", error: e

            owner.instance_variable_set(:@_event_emitter_used_actually, true)
            if owner.instance_variable_get(:@_event_emitter_lazy_init)
              primary_instance = owner.instance_variable_get(:@primary_instance)
              owner.instance_variable_set(:@router, primary_instance.router)
            end
            router = owner.instance_variable_get(:@router)
            if router.respond_to?(:caller_plugin_id=)
              router.caller_plugin_id = owner.plugin_id
            end

            if mes
              router.emit_stream(tag, mes)
            else
              router.emit(tag, time, record)
            end
          rescue => e
            if dump_error_log
              plugin_log.error "failed to emit data", error: e
            end
            code = RES_500_STATUS
            header = RES_TEXT_HEADER
            body = "500 Internal Server Error\n#{e}\n"
          end
        end

        unless code
          if respond_with_empty_img
            code, header, body = RESPONSE_IMG
          else
            if use_204_response
              code, header, body = RESPONSE_204
            else
              code, header, body = RESPONSE_200
            end
          end
        end

        body = body.to_s
        header = header.dup if header.frozen?

        unless @cors_allow_origins.nil?
          if @cors_allow_origins.include?('*')
            header['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = '*'
          elsif include_cors_allow_origin
            header['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = @origin
            if @cors_allow_credentials
              header["Access-Control-Allow-Credentials"] = true
            end
          end

        else

        end

        @io.close
      end

        @io.close if @next_close
      end

      def send_response_and_close(code, header, body)
        send_response(code, header, body)
        @next_close = true
      end

      def closing?
        @next_close
      end

      def send_response(code, header, body)
        header['Content-Length'] ||= body.bytesize
        header['Content-Type'] ||= 'text/plain'.freeze

        data = %[HTTP/1.1 #{code}\r\n]
        header.each_pair {|k,v|
          data << "#{k}: #{v}\r\n"
        }
        data << "\r\n".freeze
        @io.write(data)

        @io.write(body)
      end

      def send_response_nobody(code, header)
        data = %[HTTP/1.1 #{code}\r\n]
        header.each_pair {|k,v|
          data << "#{k}: #{v}\r\n"
        }
        data << "\r\n".freeze
        @io.write(data)
      end

      def include_cors_allow_origin
        if @origin.nil?
          return false
        end

        if @cors_allow_origins.include?(@origin)
          return true
        end
        filtered_cors_allow_origins = @cors_allow_origins.select {|origin| origin != ""}
        r = filtered_cors_allow_origins.find do |origin|
          (start_str, end_str) = origin.split("*", 2)
          @origin.start_with?(start_str) && @origin.end_with?(end_str)
        end

        !r.nil?
      end
    end
  end
